component.name: DevNet
component.summary: Split tunneling, DNS switching and local dev servers

description.p: DevNet routes chosen networks, domains and country IP ranges around your VPN and keeps those routes correct when Wi-Fi or the VPN changes.
It also switches DNS presets on every active link (including VPN links), tests the path traffic really takes, and lists local dev servers and containers with one-click open and stop actions.
The app lives in the system tray and includes a compact panel, a full native GTK4 window, GNOME shortcut support and optional passwordless operation through a small, scoped polkit rule.
Initial native Linux release with Debian and Red Hat packaging.
